prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production background for a children's English-learning journey map, MOBILE VERSION 2. This is only the empty environment layer; interactive characters and lesson labels will be overlaid separately in code.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing portrait environment opening-mobile.png. Input image 2 is a STYLE AND WORLD REFERENCE ONLY: approved-mobile-v1.png. Do not copy any UI, characters, stars, lettering or badges from input 2.
Primary request: recompose the existing environment to a TALLER PORTRAIT 2:3 canvas, ideally 1024 x 1536. Preserve the same illustrated world, camera and finish, while giving three story stations separate, generous flat places for later character overlays. Extend/recompose the environment organically, never stretch the old painting.

Invariants: retain creamy stone paths, coral and peach arches and walls, clear turquoise water flowing under arches, flowering greenery, warm sunlight from upper left, soft illustrative 3D environment with the original elevated three-quarter camera. Keep one continuous traversable winding path connecting all three stations. Keep the identifiable red-roof school with its clock, doors and rear arch wall in the upper-right. Keep the original lower circular green lawn platform, complete and unobscured.

Composition: coordinates are normalized only for your composition planning and MUST NOT be drawn. Three empty stations in a single vertically spaced world:
1. Lower-left: a complete green lawn circular platform centered approximately x=.313, y=.79. Clear flat ground for a pair of characters, with their future feet at x=.313, y=.82. Do not cut off the rim. Keep usable pale open background beneath through y=.98 so a runtime lesson label can sit there.
2. Middle: an open, modest creamy stone platform centered x=.44, y=.50, with the future character feet at x=.44, y=.52. Remove the entire giant purple umbrella and wooden umbrella crate from the old image. Keep the old simple dark lantern near the left edge of this station. Leave ample flat uncluttered paving for a separate two-person umbrella-claim counter scene. Do NOT paint a counter, umbrella or person.
3. Upper-right: preserve the school and rear coral arches, but provide a broad flat foreground school courtyard in front of the doorway, large enough for THREE full-body characters. Their future feet are around x=.735, y=.24. Keep the school readable behind, and connect its courtyard naturally to the winding stone path.
Use vertical spacing and smaller environmental buildings where needed to make the stations airy and readable on a narrow phone. Retain attractive connecting bridges and water so this still feels like the SAME approved world, not three separate panels.

Output: one full-frame opaque portrait environment painting, production finish. No transparent background. NO people, no characters, no umbrella, no counter, no wooden box, no lesson numbers, no stars, no logos, no UI, no text, no coordinate marks, no arrows or circles indicating anchors. No new world theme, no space islands, no neon, no photorealism. Do not add extra objects to fill the open staging areas.
